rule: Map M→Male and F→Female; keep Male/Female. Do not drop rows.
only drop if target, id or amount unusable
missing days_past_due treated as 0 (not reported / current); rows retained
no row drops; recoveries clipped at 0
left-join customers; unmatched loans kept with missing demo flags
drop collections whose account_id is not in loan_accounts
drop bureau lines without a customer

joins: loan_accounts LEFT JOIN customers USING customer_id
LEFT JOIN bureau features aggregated to customer_id (tradelines, utilisation, max DPD, write-offs)
LEFT JOIN collections features aggregated to account_id
LEFT JOIN repayment features aggregated to account_id IF repayment_history.csv is present
